title: True Detective Mysteries
paragraphs: True-crime dramatizations drawn from cases published in True Detective magazine, often reconstructing an actual crime from the perspectives of investigators, victims, or criminals.

Long-running true-crime anthology based on cases from True Detective Mysteries magazine. The frozen GRH subset contains 20 files representing 10 dated archive manifestations but only nine unique underlying recordings: every manifestation has a normal and 64kb encoding, and the April 1/June 12 Black Legion manifestations are the same recording reused under two dates. Local RadioGOLDINdex identifies the represented programs 1-8 as TransAmerican syndication with local commercials.

GRH documents the program through Early network period (May 16, 1929 to May 8, 1930), 1936-37 transcribed/syndicated period (September 8, 1936 to August 31, 1937), Mutual/sponsored middle period (1938 to 1945), and Later revival/transcribed period (1946 to 1959).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include true-crime case dramatization, true-crime magazine to radio adaptation, transcribed syndicated radio distribution, alternate encodes and rebroadcast preservation, murder investigation and prosecution, and criminal pursuit and case history.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including 1937 TransAmerican syndicated transcriptions, True Detective magazine case histories adapted for radio, Long-running True Detective radio property, and Frozen duplicate-encoding and rebroadcast structure.
